system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1 Slot

A memory implant provides a false set of memories, allowing you to more effectively pretend to be someone else. You gain an additional +2 bonus on tests to pretend to be that person, and any means of reading your thoughts show you are the person you are pretending to be unless the power user succeeds on a TN 17 Perception (Empathy) test.

Game modifiers on this item: commTest +2 (tests to pretend to be the person of the false memories, off). Items apply their modifiers while equipped; switch the ones that are off on when they apply.
